source_clauses.verbatim: I want a wall-mounted dispenser for small items.
It should hold about twenty of them
and release exactly one each time I press a lever, so I never get two at once.
I refill it from the top without taking it off the wall.
It must not jam when it is nearly empty.

assumptions.statement: The user will interact with the dispenser manually by pressing a lever.
assumptions.why: The request says 'I press a lever'.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the lever is automated or replaced by another control.

assumptions.statement: The dispenser is to be installed on a wall and remains there during refill.
assumptions.why: The request explicitly states 'wall-mounted' and 'without taking it off the wall'.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the dispenser is portable or not wall-mounted.

assumptions.statement: The dispenser will be used repeatedly for releasing items one at a time.
assumptions.why: The request implies repeated use and the requirement to not jam.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the dispenser is meant for single-use.
